tweets.text: Great to be with Chancellor Summer DeProw, Providence Park Founder/CEO Errin Stanger, UA-PTC Project Leader Cathy Riggins, and so many others to celebrate a nearly $2 million YouthBuild grant that will open doors for young Arkansans. This program gives students the chance to learn a trade, earn valuable certifications, and build a pathway to a good-paying career, all while helping construct tiny homes that serve those in need. Investing in our workforce means investing in Arkansas’s future. I’m grateful for the partnership between UA-PTC, Providence Park, and everyone working to create more opportunities for the next generation. #WorkforceDevelopment #YouthBuild @ProvParkHomes @pulaskitech

tweets.text: RT @DoWCTO: The @DeptofWar’s Office of Strategic Capital announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment with Niron Magnetics, Inc. (@NironMagnetics) to scale the company’s domestic production of rare earth-free magnets. Niron circumvents the concentrated and vulnerable rare earth supply chain by synthesizing magnets from domestically abundant commodity inputs, specifically iron and nitrogen. This financing will support the construction of a new manufacturing plant in Minnesota capable of producing up to 1,500 tons of rare earth-free magnets annually. This commitment helps build a secure domestic supply chain and eliminate reliance on foreign sources for magnets.
